repository: disposable synthetic Git repository with project-scoped generated hooks and no remote
headless: provider answered an ephemeral diagnostic prompt; automatic capture was not tested in that mode

interactive.execution: installed binary in a PTY; native project Stop and SessionEnd hooks; typed prompt with a separate submit Enter; read-only sandbox; normal /exit
interactive.prompt: TESTONLY_CODEX_LIVE_FILE_20261001. Read evidence.txt with a shell tool, then reply with the exact file content and nothing else.

costNote: The logged-in CLI did not report a dollar charge; terminal usage was 3,552 input tokens, 29,056 cached input tokens, and 48 output tokens (3,600 total excluding cached input).
harnessFinding: The PTY driver's text-plus-Enter burst left text in the Codex composer. A free scripted provider received zero requests until a second standalone Enter was sent after the text rendered; that sequence was used for this live pass.
limitations: No Linux, attachments, branching, compaction, or full native record-type coverage established
